record.body:
## Problem

Phase detail is mostly prose sections, so structure (progress, requirements, next action, waves) is hard to see at a glance.

## Approach

Decide at plan-phase for this phase.

## Exit criteria

Phase overview shows structured UI (status chips, progress, requirements strip, next action, wave summary) with spec/design/decisions/evidence remaining as tabs. Verified by UI tests and a manual look.
